connector.name: Nova3D by RareSense (raresense-nova3d)
connector.registryDescription: Structured, part-aware 3D generation for AI agents. Named-part GLB, preview URL, Blender script.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package nova3d-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raresense account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NOVA3D_TOKEN
env.description: Advanced/manual fallback API key from https://app.nova3d.xyz/api-key. Preferred onboarding is browser sign-in via nova3d_login.

env.name: NOVA3D_APP_URL
env.description: App URL used for conversation links, for example https://app.nova3d.xyz or http://127.0.0.1:5555
